verses.pali: Dīgha Nikāya 7
verses.english: Long Discourses 7

verses.pali: Jāliyasutta
verses.english: With Jāliya

verses.pali: Evaṁ me sutaṁ—
verses.english: So I have heard.

verses.pali: ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā kosambiyaṁ viharati ghositārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Kosambī, in Ghosita’s Monastery.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena dve pabbajitā—
verses.english: Now at that time two renunciates—

verses.pali: muṇḍiyo ca paribbājako jāliyo ca dārupattikantevāsī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṁ sammodiṁsu.
verses.english: the wanderer Muṇḍiya and Jāliya, the pupil of the wood-bowl ascetic—came to the Buddha and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ aṭṭhaṁsu. Ekamantaṁ ṭhitā kho te dve pabbajitā bhagavantaṁ etadavocuṁ:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, they stood to one side and said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “kiṁ nu kho, āvuso gotama, taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīraṁ, udāhu aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran”ti?
verses.english: “Reverend Gotama, are the soul and the body one and the same, or is the soul one thing, the body another?”

verses.pali: “Tena hāvuso, suṇātha sādhukaṁ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: “Well then, reverends, listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evamāvuso”ti kho te dve pabbajitā bhagavato paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Yes, reverend,” they replied.

verses.pali: Bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: The Buddha said this:

verses.pali: “idhāvuso, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṁ, sammāsambuddho …pe…
verses.english: “Take the case when a Realized One arises in the world, perfected, a fully awakened Buddha …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti.
verses.english: That’s how a mendicant is accomplished in ethics. …

verses.pali: …pe…
Paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: They enter and remain in the first absorption …

verses.pali: Yo kho, āvuso, bhikkhu evaṁ jānāti evaṁ passati, kallaṁ nu kho tassetaṁ vacanāya:
verses.english: When a mendicant knows and sees like this, would it be appropriate to say of them:

verses.pali: ‘taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran’ti vā ‘aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran’ti vāti.
verses.english: ‘The soul and the body are one and the same’ or ‘The soul is one thing, the body another’?”

verses.pali: Yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu evaṁ jānāti evaṁ passati, kallaṁ tassetaṁ vacanāya:
verses.english: “It would, reverend.”

verses.pali: ‘taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran’ti vā ‘aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran’ti vāti.
Ahaṁ kho panetaṁ, āvuso, evaṁ jānāmi evaṁ passāmi.
verses.english: “But reverends, I know and see like this.

verses.pali: Atha ca panāhaṁ na vadāmi:
verses.english: Nevertheless, I do not say:

verses.pali: ‘taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran’ti vā ‘aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran’ti vā …pe…
verses.english: ‘The soul and the body are one and the same’ or ‘The soul is one thing, the body another’. …

verses.pali: dutiyaṁ jhānaṁ …
verses.english: They enter and remain in the second absorption …

verses.pali: tatiyaṁ jhānaṁ …
verses.english: third absorption …

verses.pali: catutthaṁ jhānaṁ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: fourth absorption.

verses.pali: Yo kho, āvuso, bhikkhu evaṁ jānāti evaṁ passati, kallaṁ nu kho tassetaṁ vacanāya:
verses.english: When a mendicant knows and sees like this, would it be appropriate to say of them:

verses.pali: ‘taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran’ti vā ‘aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran’ti vāti?
verses.english: ‘The soul and the body are one and the same’ or ‘The soul is one thing, the body another’?”

verses.pali: Yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu evaṁ jānāti evaṁ passati kallaṁ, tassetaṁ vacanāya:
verses.english: “It would, reverend.”

verses.pali: ‘taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran’ti vā ‘aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran’ti vāti.
Ahaṁ kho panetaṁ, āvuso, evaṁ jānāmi evaṁ passāmi.
verses.english: “But reverends, I know and see like this.

verses.pali: Atha ca panāhaṁ na vadāmi:
verses.english: Nevertheless, I do not say:

verses.pali: ‘taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran’ti vā ‘aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran’ti vā …pe…
verses.english: ‘The soul and the body are one and the same’ or ‘The soul is one thing, the body another’. …

verses.pali: ñāṇadassanāya cittaṁ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti …
verses.english: They project and extend the mind toward knowledge and vision …

verses.pali: yo kho, āvuso, bhikkhu evaṁ jānāti evaṁ passati, kallaṁ nu kho tassetaṁ vacanāya:
verses.english: When a mendicant knows and sees like this, would it be appropriate to say of them:

verses.pali: ‘taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran’ti vā ‘aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran’ti vāti.
verses.english: ‘The soul and the body are one and the same’ or ‘The soul is one thing, the body another’?”

verses.pali: Yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu evaṁ jānāti evaṁ passati kallaṁ tassetaṁ vacanāya:
verses.english: “It would, reverend.”

verses.pali: ‘taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran’ti vā ‘aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran’ti vāti.
Ahaṁ kho panetaṁ, āvuso, evaṁ jānāmi evaṁ passāmi.
verses.english: “But reverends, I know and see like this.

verses.pali: Atha ca panāhaṁ na vadāmi:
verses.english: Nevertheless, I do not say:

verses.pali: ‘taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran’ti vā ‘aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran’ti vā …pe….
verses.english: ‘The soul and the body are one and the same’ or ‘The soul is one thing, the body another’. …

verses.pali: …pe… Nāparaṁ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
verses.english: They understand: ‘… there is nothing further for this place.’

verses.pali: Yo kho, āvuso, bhikkhu evaṁ jānāti evaṁ passati, kallaṁ nu kho tassetaṁ vacanāya:
verses.english: When a mendicant knows and sees like this, would it be appropriate to say of them:

verses.pali: ‘taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran’ti vā ‘aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran’ti vāti?
verses.english: ‘The soul and the body are one and the same’ or ‘The soul is one thing, the body another’?”

verses.pali: Yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu evaṁ jānāti evaṁ passati, na kallaṁ tassetaṁ vacanāya:
verses.english: “It would not, reverend.”

verses.pali: ‘taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran’ti vā ‘aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran’ti vāti.
Ahaṁ kho panetaṁ, āvuso, evaṁ jānāmi evaṁ passāmi.
verses.english: “But reverends, I know and see like this.

verses.pali: Atha ca panāhaṁ na vadāmi:
verses.english: Nevertheless, I do not say:

verses.pali: ‘taṁ jīvaṁ taṁ sarīran’ti vā ‘aññaṁ jīvaṁ aññaṁ sarīran’ti vā”ti.
verses.english: ‘The soul and the body are one and the same’ or ‘The soul is one thing, the body another’.”

verses.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā.
verses.english: That is what the Buddha said.

verses.pali: Attamanā te dve pabbajitā bhagavato bhāsitaṁ abhinandunti.
verses.english: Satisfied, the two renunciates approved what the Buddha said.

verses.pali: Jāliyasuttaṁ niṭṭhitaṁ sattamaṁ.
